annotations.title: Check your account, credits and free runs left

description: Shows who Neumann thinks you are and what you can still do: your free runs left today and when they reset, and your credit balance if you have an account. Use this when you need to know, before or after a run, whether the next call will be free or spend credits, how much is left, or whether you are signed in -- and when a run was refused for want of runs or credits, so you can tell the user which it was. There are three tiers. Without an account you get 3 free runs per UTC day; you are recognized by network address and client, so on a hosted platform such as Claude.ai or ChatGPT many callers share one identity and today's free runs may already be spent by someone else. Signed in with a free Kromatic account you get your own 10 free runs per UTC day, spent before any credits. After those, runs cost credits. An account created with POST https://neumann.kromatic.com/api/v1/accounts authenticates you and starts with 5 free credits, but it carries no free daily runs -- only signing in with a Kromatic account does. It returns whether you are anonymous or an account, your account id and status, credit balance, free runs left today with the reset time and the size limits that apply to you, the price of one credit in US dollars, and your last 10 credit transactions. Credentials go in the Authorization header as a Bearer credential and nowhere else; no Neumann tool takes an api_key argument, and a credential that is not recognized returns an unauthorized error. This tool itself needs no account -- it is how a caller without one finds that out. Setup docs: https://kromatic.com/mcp/neumann. Cost: free, with or without an account -- it debits no credits and spends none of your free daily runs.
